confirmatory_note: This study is an exploratory sensitivity analysis. Confirmatory evidence is the frozen RQ1 benchmark (results/rq1_full_benchmark) and the frozen weather ablation (results/weather_ablation). No claim of superiority may be based on this directory alone.

frozen.description: Published rule: eligible first-front routes only (utility >= 0.90 U*, count >= N* - 1 for the non-thermal planner; the frozen alpha / visit guardrails for the thermal planner), then minimum travel time (non-thermal) or minimum WES (thermal).

frozen_key_unguarded.description: Same key as the published rule but the eligibility guardrail is disabled, so a low-utility, low-travel route on the first front can win.

stability_guarded.description: Published eligibility guardrail retained, but the route with the smallest weighted itinerary edit distance wins; ties broken by travel time, then utility, then route.

stability_unguarded.description: Smallest weighted itinerary edit distance over the whole first front, with no utility or visit guardrail.  This is the pure stability-first extreme.

factor_specification.design: 2 x 2 factorial (selection key x eligibility guardrail) evaluated on one identical Pareto front per planner, scenario and seed.
factor_specification.note: The GA is executed once per (planner, scenario, seed); the four conditions differ only in how a route is chosen from the resulting front, so runtime is shared and reported identically across conditions.

direction_note: The published pipeline applies no stability penalty. The stability conditions are counterfactual additions; this study cannot show that the published method is better or worse, only what a stability term would trade.
